source_title: LADOTD Regulations for Trucks, Vehicles, and Loads (25th Edition, 2025)

superload_thresholds.note: LA has no single fixed dimensional 'superload' label; extraordinary review is weight/structure driven. Gross over 254,000 lbs requires a structural bridge evaluation ($187.50-$1,275 by structure type) plus $15 + $0.75/ton-mile over 80,000 lbs. Loads over 232,000 lbs need 4-6 weeks advance for structural review; over 900,000 lbs may require an independent engineering firm. Extraordinary width (state police over 16' wide, front+rear police over 18' wide) and length (state police over 125') also trigger case-by-case handling.

width.note: 1 private escort; front on 2-lane, rear (plus pole car) on multilane
state police escort required over 16' wide on all state highways
front and rear state police escorts required over 18' wide

height.note: pole truck/car with height indicator required over 15'10" on state-maintained highways; exempt if travel is Interstate-only
utility-lifting pole truck required over 16'8"; bucket truck may be required by Permit Office
bucket truck required for all loads over 18' high; loads over 18' high may require front and rear state police escorts

length.note: state police escort over 125'; hauling trailers must have steerable/trackable dollies

single_trip.fee_formula: Oversize single trip via prepaid A-Form = $10 per day (oversize only, one trip/one day). Overweight fees are schedule-based by excess weight and distance: Schedule #1 (1-3 over-axle groups) $30-$735, over 60,000 lbs excess = $15 + $0.10/ton-mile; Schedule #3 (5+ axles over 80,000 gross) $45-$2,130 by gross weight & miles, over 254,000 lbs = $15 + $0.75/ton-mile over 80,000 plus structural evaluation.
single_trip.note: A-Form single trip permits are one day; mobile home permits are 3 days. Overweight permit cost depends on the fee schedule for the axle/gross configuration and mileage.

annual.note: Category-specific annual/blanket permits, e.g. Annual Overweight $2,500/yr; Agronomic/Horticultural $100/yr; Off-Road Non-Critical $1,000/yr; Containerized Cargo $50-$3,000; Escort Vehicle Permit $10/yr; Forest Product $10/yr.

movement_restrictions: Loads over 12' wide are prohibited from weekday (Mon-Fri) travel during rush hours (7:00-9:00 AM and 3:30-5:30 PM) in designated Interstate segments of Shreveport, Monroe, Lake Charles, Baton Rouge, and New Orleans

Loads projecting beyond boundaries, or over 8'6" wide / 14'4" high / 70' long, or over 120,000 lbs are prohibited on the US-190 Mississippi River Bridge (Baton Rouge) 6:30-9:00 AM and 3:30-6:00 PM Mon-Fri
Permitted loads may not travel during physically severe weather (heavy rain, fog, ice, snow, low visibility)
Loads with legal width/length, height 14'4" or less, and gross under 120,000 lbs are generally NOT prohibited at night, in moderate weather, or on holidays
notes: Legal width 102" (8'6"); legal height 14'0" Interstate / 13'6" non-Interstate; max legal gross 80,000 lbs without tridem/quadrum (higher by axle group with tridem/quadrum). Semi-trailers on Designated Truck Routes may run 59'6".

Combinations over 120,000 up to 254,000 lbs may run tandem axles to 45,000 lbs and steer to 13,000 lbs with 12' group spreads and 4' tire spreads; loads over 232,000 up to 254,000 lbs travel statewide on DOTD-approved (mostly Interstate) routes.
